scope: Production renderer UI in Electron 44.4.3 with controlled synthetic IPC fixtures; no Codex/provider connection, user project, or live Sunny profile was used. The editor check waits for the rendered fixture contents and normalizes Monaco's nonbreaking-space display.

fullNodeSuite.credentialSafety: No .env file or key value was read; tests used their controlled fixture configuration.

checks: snapshot race keeps newer state
task family search and filtering
specialist approval and duplicate approval guard
separate captain and specialist drafts
draft retention across navigation and UI reload
suggested skills can be selected or removed
failed task start preserves the brief
duplicate task start is rejected
editor and terminal bundles load lazily
file navigation stops at the registered project root
Monaco editor loads
unknown-task recovery error remains visible
status check does not stop running work; explicit stop works
Inbox and island navigation render
compact layout has no horizontal overflow
late launch response does not steal navigation
late launch clears only the submitted brief
newer draft survives a late successful launch
dirty editor blocks project switch
starting a task preserves the dirty editor buffer
failed snapshot exposes retry; early streamed state beats stale snapshot
limitations: This tests the renderer and state transitions against fixture IPC, not real provider behavior or the active user's Sunny data.
It does not exercise a packaged executable, real filesystem writes, PR/CI/deployment operations, or acceptance of a live mission.

The separate packaged editor-save repeat remains partial: OneDrive app-created/PowerShell-created saves and stale-write rejection passed, but the temp-root UI timed out before attempting a save. See packaged-editor-save-repeat-2026-09-22.json.
